messages:
morgan: Quick design pass request — iterating on compact pool row density + SLO tooltip parity across desktop/mobile. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/compact-pool-rows (mock v1/v2). Key asks: shrink avatar stack so pool name + SLO aren't truncated, make SLO slider tooltip accessible/consistent on focus and hover, and tighten burst help flow microcopy. PTAL :eyes:

 alex: I like the direction. A11y note: VoiceOver reads the native range poorly. We should expose aria-valuetext like 'SLO target: 200 ms (p95)'. Also ensure keyboard focus shows the same tooltip content as hover. :accessibility:

 sam: Quick copy tweaks — two options for the burst helper: 1) 'Burst: temporary extra capacity' 2) 'Burst: short-term capacity increase (pay-as-you-go)'. I prefer option 2 because it's clearer about cost.

 maya: Uploaded two screenshots to Figma showing tighter avatar stack and full-width SLO slider. Variant A keeps tooltip on hover only, Variant B anchors a small hint under the slider for screen readers. Link: https://www.figma.com/proto/abc/compact-rows

 jordan: FYI engineering constraints: slider is currently a custom component built on top of <input type="range"> with virtualization for the pool list. Making persistent hint visible for screen readers will need an aria-live region and a tiny perf check for the virtualized rows (changing DOM might force reflow). Also pool avatar changes could alter row height — virtualization will need the new height.

 morgan: Good call. Proposal: compact avatar (left), pool name truncated to 2 lines, SLO slider occupies remaining row width. Tooltip behavior: on hover show small tooltip, on keyboard focus announce via aria-live and show inline hint. Burst toast copy suggestion: 'Burst uses spare GPU capacity and may incur extra charges. Set a burst cap to limit spend.' + 'Learn more' link.

 alex: Step size question — keyboard steps currently at 1 unit (raw). For SLO slider, what granularity do we want? 1ms steps might be noisy; maybe 5ms or 1% steps depending on unit. Also ensure step changes announce delta: 'increased by 5ms'.

 sam: Inline microcopy options for SLO tooltip (short and long):

 ```
 Short: 'SLO target (p95 latency) — slide to increase priority.'
 Long: 'Service Level Objective (p95). Higher targets increase capacity allocation and cost.'
 ```
 I lean long for the modal/help and short for the hover tooltip.

 maya: I'll mock two accessibility variants: 1) inline persistent hint + aria-live 2) hover tooltip + focus-announcement only. Will also try a compact avatar badge (stacked initials) vs single tiny avatar. Will share screenshots in ~2h.

 jordan: From infra side, if we keep row height stable we avoid virtualization recalcs. Prefer variant that doesn't change row height on hover. Also can we lazy-load the tooltip component to keep initial paint fast?

 morgan: Agreed on stable height. Let's favor variant A if it passes a quick accessibility check. Maya — please include keyboard walkthrough steps in the mock so QA can test.

 design-bot: Uploaded mock_vA and mock_vB to Figma and added comments. morgan updated the file. :white_check_mark:

 alex: TL;DR: prefer compact avatar + full-width slider, persistent small hint for a11y, tighten burst microcopy to mention cost. I'll add a checklist for accessibility and keyboard behavior. :thumbsup:
